biggest_catch: The $200 credit requires maintaining a $2,500 average monthly balance for each of the first three months after the month you open — parking $2,500 in a new business account for ~4 months — and the whole offer rides on a 'coupon' with no stated expiry date beyond 'limited time offer.'
catches: No stated expiry — 'limited time offer' only; verify it is still live before opening.

$200 credit: maintain a $2,500 average monthly balance for each of the first three months following the month of account opening; account must be opened within 30 days of receiving the coupon; credited within 45 days of meeting requirements.

$100 credit: a Business Debit Card must be added when the account is opened, and 6 point-of-sale transactions (signature or PIN) must post over the first three months following the month of account opening.
New business checking customers only; coupon is non-transferable and must be presented at account opening.
Maximum combined $300 per account, one per business entity; subject to 1099 tax reporting.
Business checking available only to businesses operating in Dollar Bank's markets (OH/PA/VA/MD footprint). Free Business Checking has no monthly fee or balance requirement otherwise.
Merchant processing/card payment services are optional and require separate approval.

steps: Obtain the Dollar Bank Free Business Checking $300 coupon/offer (coupon must be presented at account opening; the $200 credit requires opening within 30 days of receiving the coupon).
Open a new Free Business Checking account as a new business customer in a Dollar Bank market and add a Business Debit Card at opening.
Maintain a $2,500 average monthly balance for each of the first three months following the month of account opening to earn the $200 credit.
Post 6 point-of-sale transactions (signature or PIN) with the business debit card over the first three months following the month of account opening to earn the $100 credit.
Keep the account in good standing; each credit is added within 45 days of meeting its requirements.
timing: Each credit ($200 and $100) is added to the new business checking account within 45 days of meeting the offer requirements.
